notes: Four conversation voices for page 36. English A and Spanish A are the same kind of speaker in each language: a woman in her forties. English B and Spanish B are a man in his early sixties. Each voice is designed in its own language and clones only that language.

en_a.instruct: A friendly adult woman in her forties. Medium pitch, clear American English, warm and conversational, bright but not high, natural speaking voice, unhurried, not breathy, not theatrical.
en_a.ref_en: Do you use WhatsApp? I love that a friend can send me a pin so I can find their house. It is amazing how much technology has changed, and I really love it.
en_a.ref_es: ¿Usas WhatsApp? Me encanta que un amigo me envíe un pin para encontrar su casa. Es increíble cuánto ha cambiado la tecnología.

en_b.instruct: A friendly adult man in his early sixties. Deeper pitch, clear American English, warm and relaxed, slightly slower, a natural speaking voice, reflective, not gravelly, not booming.
en_b.ref_en: Yes, it would be hard to live in Volcán without it. I had the phone numbers of all my friends memorized, and now I have trouble remembering my own.
en_b.ref_es: Sí, sería difícil vivir en Volcán sin él. Me sabía de memoria los números de todos mis amigos, y ahora tengo problemas para recordar el mío.

es_a.instruct: A friendly adult woman in her forties. Medium pitch, clear Latin American Spanish, warm and conversational, bright but not high, natural speaking voice, unhurried, not breathy, not theatrical.
es_a.ref_en: Do you use WhatsApp? I love that a friend can send me a pin so I can find their house. It is amazing how much technology has changed.
es_a.ref_es: ¿Usas WhatsApp? Me encanta que un amigo me envíe un código para encontrar su casa. Es increíble cómo ha cambiado la tecnología, y lo mejor es que es gratis.

es_b.instruct: A friendly adult man in his early sixties. Deeper pitch, clear Latin American Spanish, warm and relaxed, slightly slower, a natural speaking voice, reflective, not gravelly, not booming.
es_b.ref_en: Yes, it would be hard to live there without it. I had every friend's phone number memorized, and now I have trouble remembering my own.
es_b.ref_es: Sí, sería difícil vivir en Volcán sin él. Me sabía de memoria los números de todos mis amigos, y ahora ya tengo problemas para recordar el mío.
